title: Finite Nash Equilibrium Computation Examples
body_html:
Finite Nash Equilibrium Computation Examples

MFoGT Exercise 4.12.1 asks for all pure and mixed Nash equilibria in several finite games: four two-player matrix games and one three-player game where the third player chooses which matrix is used.

This node records the exercise as a source of finite Nash computation examples. The individual equilibrium computations can be split into separate example nodes if needed.

References

  • [MFoGT, Section 4.12, Exercise 1] Laraki, Renault, and Sorin, Mathematical Foundations of Game Theory. Exercise asking to compute pure and mixed Nash equilibria in several finite games.
